gt_provenance.details: Frozen deterministic fault oracle is valid for regression; 2048 decisions are targeted mutations of 256 real rollouts, not natural incident ground truth.

score_normalization.details: No deceptive self-normalization found; replay still requires synthetic-drift qualifier.

result_existence.details: Current v0.1.0 snapshot passes 327 checksums and event verification, but two of three v0.2.0-dev checksums mismatch and historical version directories were mutated after releases.

dead_code.details: Custom guarded loop calls guarded_optimizer_step, but official GuardedGRPOTrainer does not compare actual inputs and does not gate the real optimizer step.

scope.details: Single Qwen3-4B family, single-box two-GPU, short hand-written math tasks; no multi-node, NPU, or real agent benchmark.
